{{Conjecture|legends}}
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], an '''uprising''' by the population of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Charis]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] attempted to overthrow their [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] oppressors. In retaliation, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]], ruler of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], ordered his [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] to [[Subjugation of Charis|put down the rebellion]]. One hundred and fifty million citizens were killed as the Empire retook control of the planet.
